Phase 1: Risk Assessment and Planning

Review the client profile. Set overall materiality and assess inherent risk for key accounts and control risk.

Typical range: 3-5% of pre-tax income or 0.5-1% of revenue

Phase 2: Internal Controls Testing

Select exactly 5 controls to test. Then assess overall control effectiveness.

Phase 3: Substantive Testing

Design substantive test procedures for three high-risk accounts and set your sample size.

Phase 4: Findings and Audit Opinion

Review all evidence and select the red flags you identified. Then form your audit opinion.
